what.text: This page follows refugees from Syria living in Jordan.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 420835 Syrian refugees in Jordan, 8.6% of all Syrian refugees.
Türkiye, Germany and Lebanon host more.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Syria from 2011 to 2025, with Syrian insurgents, at war level from 2011 to 2020 and in 2023 and 2024.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2013 to 2025, and over Rojava Kurdistan territory with the PYD from 2012 to 2015.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2013 to 2025, after big changes between 2011 and 2013.
UNHCR's figure for Jordan peaked at 676283 in 2018 and fell to 420835 by 2025.
Returns from Jordan to Syria were highest in 2025 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Jordan only, and UNHCR adds notes to some of them.
People displaced inside Syria are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Jordan they live.
